selected_topics.lesson_subject: TCP congestion control with BBR: model the bottleneck instead of waiting for loss
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Global FortiOS TCP sender congestion-control selection between default CUBIC and model-based BBR using bottleneck bandwidth and propagation RTT.
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: TCP sender pacing -> bottleneck bandwidth/RTT model -> ACK-derived delivery feedback -> pacing/cwnd adjustment; configured globally rather than per firewall policy.
selected_topics.failure_class: Low TCP goodput on a congested or high-RTT path; a policy-only change is incorrectly expected to alter the global TCP algorithm.
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: config system global read-back proves selected algorithm; controlled same-path transfer plus RTT/loss/retransmission measurements tests outcome; neither alone proves an application is healthy.
selected_topics.remediation_path: A/B test CUBIC and BBR under identical path, policy, endpoints and load; change globally in a controlled window; revert to CUBIC if fairness or stability regresses.
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: Global BBR selection; controlled CUBIC/BBR A-B test; TCP-only/global scope; configuration-versus-performance evidence.
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Closed-loop TCP sender -> bottleneck -> ACK feedback -> BBR bandwidth/RTT estimator -> pacing controller.
